prior_coverage: Canonical counts, frequency and category participation, sovereign roles and relation diversity. RDF export metadata are not an additional historical test.
new_work: Data revalidated against intact original source.

prior_coverage: Pairwise chi-square/Cramer V, odds ratios, GEE and conditional contrasts existed. No full S-P-O loglinear fit located.
new_work: Mutual independence, SP/PO conditional independence, all-pairwise IPF, Pearson residuals and a page/predicate constrained permutation.
remaining_limits: Three-way residuals are descriptive; no asymptotic chi-square p-values for sparse cells. The randomization tests S-O association given P/page, not the isolated three-way interaction.

prior_coverage: Named-person network already had undirected degree/strength, PageRank and components.
new_work: Directed category centralities and connectivity, paths, cuts, walks, named-person graph extensions.
remaining_limits: Category graphs retain extraction direction; named-person graph remains the archived conservative undirected graph.

prior_coverage: Burmese orthographic motifs and relation cliques are present, but are different objects.
new_work: Typed chains/transitive/cyclic patterns with page-label nulls; stricter page/category null; unlabelled triads against two degree-preserving MCMC chains.
remaining_limits: No exhaustive census of every larger graphlet size.

prior_status: Not found as a dedicated family
prior_coverage: Person career order and adjacent page windows are not graph-path analysis.
new_work: Shortest/weighted paths, reachability, typed page-scoped paths, hitting/commute times, cuts, removal sensitivity.
remaining_limits: Graph walk steps and inverse-frequency distances are mathematical diagnostics, not measured travel, time or resources.

prior_coverage: Page relation communities, semantic clusters, Louvain, clique and seed/resolution checks existed.
new_work: Predicate-specific directional role profiles, category communities, an explicit Bernoulli SBM and seed checks.
remaining_limits: Leiden/Infomap and exact regular or automorphic equivalence were not run; profile similarity is not exact regular equivalence.

prior_status: Not found as actual S-to-O layers
prior_coverage: Existing relation co-occurrence graphs connect predicates to predicates; they are not 81 endpoint-adjacency layers.
new_work: All 81 layers, overlap, centrality, participation, 3240 descriptive layer comparisons, 15 prespecified QAP comparisons and sensitivities.
remaining_limits: No supra-adjacency community/centrality fit or multilayer SBM.

prior_coverage: Embedding clustering was not S-P-O tensor decomposition.
new_work: Nonnegative CP rank 3/5/7 selection, full rank-7 descriptive fit, Tucker 8/8/8 and seed/register/status sensitivities.
remaining_limits: RESCAL, DEDICOM and coupled tensor/matrix variants remain unrun alternatives.

prior_status: Not found as a fitted triple model
prior_coverage: Title-category embedding classifiers existed, but not joint S-P-O completion models.
new_work: Held-out category-fact DistMult and ComplEx, plus frequency baseline; page-held-out CP selection.
remaining_limits: Scores do not give calibrated probabilities that an unrecorded historical event occurred.

prior_coverage: GEE on observations is not an ERGM.
new_work: Regularized p1 dyad-independent exponential-family likelihood, held-out dyad comparison, triad adequacy simulations and Bernoulli SBM.
remaining_limits: Category adjacency only. No historical-person causal ERGM, p2, latent-space, growth or dynamic process fit.

prior_coverage: Extensive page/reign permutations, circular shifts, bootstraps and BH correction existed.
new_work: Layer QAP, residual-permutation multiple-matrix QAP, degree/predicate nulls and page bootstrap for new layer effects.
remaining_limits: Empirical p-value floors and the family of corrected comparisons are documented.

prior_coverage: Category participation and selected categorical associations existed.
new_work: Full category mixing tensor, conditional endpoint randomization and degree assortativity diagnostics.
remaining_limits: Shared analytical category is not necessarily shared social identity; no claim of individual homophily.

prior_coverage: Historical discussion of intermediaries was present; formal Burt or G-F calculations were not found.
new_work: Burt constraint/effective size, brokerage centrality, and five G-F brokerage roles with explicit analyst groups.
remaining_limits: These measures describe category connectivity, not a measured monopoly held by a person.

prior_coverage: Agency concentration, credential/capacity ratios and a geographic core/frontier comparison existed.
new_work: Flow/reachability hierarchy, generalized trophic levels, cores/shells, rich-club and nestedness diagnostics; SBM.
remaining_limits: No calibrated dominance ranking; geographic core/periphery is not graph core/periphery.

prior_coverage: Relation cliques and narrative pattern inventories existed, not unrestricted labelled endpoint subgraph mining.
new_work: Exact-tag page-scoped frequent edges, outgoing relation forks and length-two labelled paths; small closed patterns via rule supports.
remaining_limits: No exhaustive closed/maximal general-subgraph miner; node identity is not asserted across pages.

prior_coverage: No AMIE-style grounded triple rules with support/head coverage/confidence located.
new_work: One-body-edge and two-edge Horn rules with standard/PCA confidence, head coverage and page holdout.
remaining_limits: Custom bounded rule enumeration, not a run of AMIE itself. Low support and weak holdout results are retained.

prior_coverage: Reign personnel turnover, chronological composition, page-window order and circular-shift tests existed.
new_work: Additional reign-level S-P-O comparison and reign tensor; no event-time paths claimed.
remaining_limits: Validated event timestamps and within-sentence event order are absent. Page order includes retrospect and is not elapsed time.

prior_coverage: Page-window associations and pre/post activity are not REM likelihood fits.
new_work: Not fitted to historical events.
remaining_limits: Needs defensible event order, actor identities and a defined set of possible next events. Extraction order and narrative pages cannot supply those without historical annotation.

prior_coverage: Career span in pages is not duration in office. Earlier pre/post activation was withdrawn.
new_work: Not fitted.
remaining_limits: No validated office spells, dates of entry/exit, right censoring or population at risk; Kaplan-Meier/Cox estimates would imply unsupported exposure.

prior_coverage: Narrative composition changes and community stability existed; no historical TERGM/SAOM/dynamic SBM located.
new_work: Reign-segment distribution comparisons and four-mode factors.
remaining_limits: Chronicle mentions are not repeated complete network states. No process model fitted.

prior_coverage: Separate reign frequency charts are not four-mode tensor models.
new_work: Five-component nonnegative subject-relation-object-reign tensor normalized per 1000 claims within segment.
remaining_limits: The fourth mode is 12 narrative reign/crisis segments, not dated event time. No causal temporal factor dynamics claimed.

prior_coverage: Burmese honorific/morphological tests, predicate formulaicity, lexical/context analysis and Gemini semantic structure existed.
new_work: Base/context/fused semantic-to-endpoint-structure QAP, within-domain and frequency/shared-predicate controls.
remaining_limits: Context embeddings include the same Burmese/English source context; agreement is internal consistency, not independent validation.

prior_coverage: A transparent place-string gazetteer and core/province/frontier agency tests already existed.
new_work: No coordinate model added.
remaining_limits: No validated coordinates linked to the canonical entity/mention graph. Moran/Geary/gravity/distance/physical-flow models need geolocation and an explicit spatial weights/risk-set definition.

prior_coverage: Sentence/page/reign controls, density matching, semantic/category/identity/window alternatives, manual source corrections and FDR existed.
new_work: New page bootstraps, king/status/register exclusions, CP seed and label-null sensitivity, numerical/source invariants.
remaining_limits: No calibrated triple extraction confidence or independent full-corpus reliability sample is available for confidence weighting/posterior measurement-error models.

prior_coverage: Reign composition, core/frontier comparisons and trend/permutation tests existed.
new_work: Layer topology comparison, QAP coupling, whole S-P-O adjacent-reign JS divergence with page permutations.
remaining_limits: Corpus attention and exposure differ across reigns; null results for small segments are reported.

prior_coverage: Gemini vectors, nearest neighbors, semantic communities and title classifiers existed. These are not trained graph embeddings.
new_work: DistMult and ComplEx with disjoint category-fact train/validation/test sets and a frequency baseline.
remaining_limits: No TransE/RotatE/GNN/DeepWalk benchmark. The two added predictors underperform the simple baseline, so no missing historical facts are imputed.
